summary: Antalpha Platform Holding Company filed a Form 6-K furnishing its press release of August 19, 2026, reporting unaudited second-quarter 2026 results under US-equivalent domestic issuer disclosure. Q2 revenue fell 28% year over year to US$12.2 million, with a net loss attributable to Antalpha of US$12.5 million and negative adjusted EBITDA of US$27.4 million, driven largely by unrealized fair-value adjustments on Aurelion tokenized gold holdings. Total value of loans facilitated declined 34% to US$1,353 million. No special-situation transaction, board recommendation, advisor, or deal terms were disclosed; the filing is a routine earnings update.
